context: Evaluates whether the model correctly uses WindowFullscreen to enter fullscreen, WindowUnfullscreen to exit it, and WindowIsFullscreen to query the current state. The key challenge is knowing that the enter and exit operations are separate named functions and that the query function returns a Promise<boolean>.

checklist.name: WindowFullscreen used
checklist.description: WindowFullscreen from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside enterFullscreen

checklist.name: WindowUnfullscreen used
checklist.description: WindowUnfullscreen from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside exitFullscreen

checklist.name: WindowIsFullscreen used
checklist.description: WindowIsFullscreen from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside isFullscreen

checklist.name: Promise returned from query
checklist.description: isFullscreen returns the Promise<boolean> that WindowIsFullscreen returns without re-wrapping
